plans.title: Local Roadway Safety Plan
plans.method: The plan ranked locations by a severity-weighted score of police-reported crashes from 2017 through 2021, so its order differs from the counts on this site.

plans.title: Transit-Oriented Development Pedestrian Access Plan
plans.short: the city's 2022 plan for walking to Caltrain stations
plans.method: This plan recommends changes on walking routes near the Downtown, Hayward Park and Hillsdale Caltrain stations and along El Camino Real. It doesn't rank them. The changes listed here are grouped into plain categories; the plan's project list has the full wording.
